description: Extension of ChannelsStore class providing lifecycle management methods such as start, stop, refresh, and WhatsApp/Telegram login/logout procedures.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts polling task for channel status updates and configuration loading.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes channel status snapshot, handles errors, and updates last success/error timestamps.

methods.name: startWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Initiates WhatsApp login process, optionally auto-waits for login completion.

methods.name: waitWhatsAppLogin
methods.description: Waits for WhatsApp login to complete within a specified timeout.

methods.name: logoutWhatsApp
methods.description: Logs out and clears WhatsApp session.

methods.name: logoutTelegram
methods.description: Logs out Telegram session and updates configuration status.
